Guwahati High Court rules against man's citizenship despite multiple documents

The Guwahati High Court has ruled that Aminul Haque is not an Indian citizen, despite him presenting 15 to 16 documents, including a PAN card and Voter ID. His father's claim of parentage was also rejected by the court. The case highlights the stringent requirements and judicial scrutiny involved in citizenship determination.
